text: No tribe could hold the sky alone. Soil without Stone is warmth with nowhere to stand. Spark without Clock is a beat with no song. Sigil without Spindle is a promise with no road home.

The old world was not peace. It was maintenance. Eight pulls became eight arguments, and the ninth, the Loom-stitchers' own, was the seam they tore along. Then the rest went like a rope through a hand.
The Cut was not a war. It was nine jobs left undone in the same breath.
